_comment: Punch-list 3.6. The authority on what a hair groom IS, read by the build, by the asset gate
and by the runtime — the same arrangement assets/wardrobe/manifest.json has, and for the same
reason: two files that each decide a garment's alphaMode independently will disagree, and the
disagreement is invisible until a judge looks at a plate.
Hair is deliberately NOT in the wardrobe manifest. It has no clo rating, no layer, no
formality and cannot be taken off, so resolving it through the garment clause would make that
clause the authority on a thing with none of the fields it reads.
The GLBs beside this file are BUILD OUTPUT and are gitignored. Rebuild with:

grooms.description: Side-parted, face-framing, roughly to the collarbone. The default groom.

flow.channels: RG strand tangent, B root-to-tip, A strand id
